verification_gates.name: TypeScript typecheck
verification_gates.command: cd apps/desktop && npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit

items.description: Create TestButton component and render it on the main page
steps: Export a React component that renders a <button> with text 'Test Button'
Import and render <TestButton /> in the main app page

items.description: Add Playwright e2e test that asserts TestButton renders with correct text
steps: Add a test spec in apps/desktop/tests/e2e/core/ that navigates to the app and asserts the button with text 'Test Button' exists
Run pnpm test:e2e:core and confirm the test passes
